blocks.text: The building management office sent a notice this afternoon about the garage. I am passing it on because the three of us hold the firm's parking permits. First, the garage will close after business on Wednesday for resurfacing. It will then stay closed through the holiday and the weekend that follows. It reopens on Monday morning, and our permits will work as before.

During the closure, permit holders may use the public lot across the street by showing their permit at the booth. I have saved the notice to the office folder on the shared drive. If either of you would like a printed copy for the attendant, please tell me by Wednesday afternoon and I will leave one on your desk.
